newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WAPET oil partners appoint managing director.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WAPET oil partners appoint managing director.

text.p: West Australian Petroleum Pty Ltd (WAPET), the operator of the Barrow and Thevenard island oilfields off Western Australia, said on Wednesday that Boidy Sibley had been appointed managing director, effective in May.

Sibley was currently vice president-exploration and technology for Caltex Pacific Indonesia. He will replace Robert Young who was WAPET managing director for four years and who would become president of the Chevron Petroleum Co in Colombia.
WAPET is a joint venture between Texaco Inc, Chevron Inc and Royal Dutch Shell Group, each with two-sevenths stakes, and Mobil Corp with one-seventh.
